Full-range (v2-style):              Concentrated (v3-style):
  liquidity spread $0 -> infinity     liquidity spread only $1,800-$2,200
  most of it never gets touched       all of it sits where price actually is
  lower fee income per dollar         higher fee income per dollar,
  deposited                           IF price stays inside the range
caption: Uniswap v3's core idea: stop paying for capital that sits at prices nobody trades at.

code:
ETH trading near $2,000 USDC:

Full-range LP:
  ~1-2% of deposited capital is active near $2,000 at any moment

Concentrated LP, range $1,800-$2,200:
  SAME dollar amount, but ALL of it sits inside the range
  -> same fee-earning depth using ~10-20x LESS total capital
caption: Same fees, far less capital tied up -- or the same capital, far more fee income.

code:
If price moves OUTSIDE your chosen range:
  -> position converts entirely into the now-cheaper asset
  -> you earn ZERO trading fees until price re-enters
  -> you must choose: withdraw, wait, or re-range

A full-range position never "runs out of range" --
it just always earns less efficiently.
caption: Concentrated liquidity turns LP management into an active, ongoing decision.
